answer: Epoch-staggered activation quota resists sybils: only a fixed small number of new identities can ACTIVATE per epoch (a deterministic queue), so a burst of registrations drains through a narrow per-epoch gate over many epochs. A nectar-rush of ten thousand fakes registering at once must wait in the quartz queue, activating only a handful per epoch — the attacker's effective fleet grows at the quota rate, not instantly. An honest newcomer waits one short turn; a flash-army is stretched across a long activation horizon, copper-slow and exposed to detection throughout.
